amount-hero.purpose: Checkout amount due and completion amount. 36px at 1024.

amount-total.purpose: Sale grand total and ledger totals. 24px at 1024 compact.

screen-title.purpose: One per screen, in the titlebar.

control-lg.purpose: Primary commit button and tender tile labels.

body-strong.purpose: Product names, labels and button text.

money-row.purpose: Line prices and ledger rows, mono tabular.

meta.purpose: Hints, secondary names, timestamps. Never below 12px.

kbd.purpose: Keyboard-hint chips only; the one place 11px is allowed.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Dialogs, manager approval sheet, lock screen. The only shadow new work uses.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Standard state-change easing. No springs, overshoot or bounce; zero duration under prefers-reduced-motion.

breakpoints.name: screen-too-small
breakpoints.purpose: Below this width the terminal shows ScreenTooSmall (Arabic copy).

breakpoints.name: compact-workspace
breakpoints.purpose: Container query, not a viewport breakpoint: the compact density profile applies when the v5-screen workspace is 1120px wide or less (shipped in live-sale.css). Under Direction B that is a 1024 window; a 1280 window stays comfortable.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one next action in a region. At most one filled-teal control per region.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-block-size: 44px; padding-inline: 16px; border-radius: 10px; font-family: 'Dubai', 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, Arial, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.25, 1), border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.25, 1); background-color: var(--color-primary, #0f766e); border: 1px solid var(--color-primary, #0f766e); color: #ffffff; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-color: var(--color-primary-emphasis, #0b5b55); border-color: var(--color-primary-emphasis, #0b5b55); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary, #0f766e); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Commit Button
components.description: Large full-width commit at the bottom of the money column: «الدفع» on Sale, «تأكيد الدفع» on Checkout. No key hint is shown: no shortcut is bound yet (VN-S5).
components.css: .ds-btn-commit { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-block-size: 44px; padding-inline: 16px; border-radius: 10px; font-family: 'Dubai', 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, Arial, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.25, 1), border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.25, 1); inline-size: 100%; min-block-size: 56px; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 700; background-color: var(--color-primary, #0f766e); border: 1px solid var(--color-primary, #0f766e); color: #ffffff; } .ds-btn-commit:hover { background-color: var(--color-primary-emphasis, #0b5b55); } .ds-btn-commit:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary, #0f766e); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Supporting action beside a primary; white surface with the Control Edge boundary.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-block-size: 44px; padding-inline: 16px; border-radius: 10px; font-family: 'Dubai', 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, Arial, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.25, 1), border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.25, 1); background-color: var(--color-surface, #ffffff); border: 1px solid var(--color-border-strong, #6f7b89); color: var(--color-text, #0f1d2e); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background-color: var(--color-surface-elevated, #f3f6fa); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary, #0f766e); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive consequence — void, cancel sale. Spatially separated from frequent actions; never the default focus.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-block-size: 44px; padding-inline: 16px; border-radius: 10px; font-family: 'Dubai', 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, Arial, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.25, 1), border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.25, 1); background-color: var(--color-danger, #b3261e); border: 1px solid var(--color-danger, #b3261e); color: #ffffff; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background-color: var(--color-danger-emphasis, #8c1d18); border-color: var(--color-danger-emphasis, #8c1d18); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary, #0f766e); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Scan Target

components.css: .ds-scan { display: grid; gap: 4px; font-family: 'Dubai', 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, Arial, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-scan-label { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-text-muted, #53647a); } .ds-scan-input { min-block-size: 44px; padding-inline: 12px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border-strong, #6f7b89); background-color: var(--color-surface-sunken, #eef2f6); color: var(--color-text, #0f1d2e); font-family: 'Dubai', 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, Arial, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-scan-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary, #0f766e); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-scan-owner { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--color-text, #0f1d2e); } .ds-dot { inline-size: 8px; block-size: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background-color: var(--color-primary, #0f766e); }

components.name: Tender Tile
components.description: Tender method tile: selected uses Teal Wash; disabled-by-policy stays visible with a reason (RT-103 voucher).
components.css: .ds-tiles { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 10px; } .ds-tile { display: grid; place-content: center; gap: 4px; min-block-size: 72px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border-strong, #6f7b89); background-color: var(--color-surface, #ffffff); color: var(--color-text, #0f1d2e); font-family: 'Dubai', 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, Arial, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tile:hover { background-color: var(--color-surface-elevated, #f3f6fa); } .ds-tile:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary, #0f766e); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-tile[aria-pressed='true'] { background-color: var(--color-primary-soft, #e6f4f1); color: var(--color-primary, #0f766e); border-color: var(--color-primary, #0f766e); } .ds-tile:disabled { background-color: var(--color-surface-sunken, #eef2f6); color: var(--color-text-muted, #53647a); cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-tile small { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 400; } @media (forced-colors: active) { .ds-tile { border-color: ButtonText; } .ds-tile[aria-pressed='true'] { background-color: Highlight; color: HighlightText; border-color: Highlight; } .ds-tile:disabled { color: GrayText; border-color: GrayText; } }

components.name: Navigation Link
components.description: Nav entry; active uses Teal Wash, Pharmacy Teal ink, a 2px inline-start bar and aria-current.
components.html: البيعالمبيعات
components.css: .ds-nav { display: grid; gap: 4px; inline-size: 140px; font-family: 'Dubai', 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, Arial, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-link { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; min-block-size: 44px; padding-inline: 12px; border-radius: 10px; color: var(--color-text-muted, #53647a); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-link:hover { background-color: var(--color-surface-elevated, #f3f6fa); color: var(--color-text, #0f1d2e); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary, #0f766e); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-nav-link[aria-current] { background-color: var(--color-primary-soft, #e6f4f1); color: var(--color-primary, #0f766e); } .ds-nav-link[aria-current]::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset-inline-start: 0; inset-block: 10px; inline-size: 2px; background-color: var(--color-primary, #0f766e); } @media (forced-colors: active) { .ds-nav-link[aria-current] { background-color: Highlight; color: HighlightText; } .ds-nav-link[aria-current]::before { background-color: HighlightText; } }

components.name: Offline Banner
components.description: Persistent warning banner for offline selling; the sale continues. Never auto-dismisses.
components.html: أنت تعمل دون اتصال. المبيعات تُحفظ على هذا الجهاز وتُرسل تلقائيًا عند عودة الاتصال.
components.css: .ds-banner { display: block; padding: 10px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--color-warning, #a35a00); border-radius: 10px; background-color: var(--color-warning-soft, #fdf1e0); color: var(--color-text, #0f1d2e); font-family: 'Dubai', 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, Arial, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.6; } .ds-banner strong { color: var(--color-warning, #a35a00); }

components.name: Sale Total

narrative.overview:
The terminal is a calm clinical instrument on a pharmacy counter. It is read at arm's length, under overhead light, by a cashier whose hands are on a scanner and a keyboard while a customer waits. Every screen answers three questions in this order: what is in the sale and what does it cost, what is the one next thing to do, and is anything not proven yet. Anything not yet proven — payment UNKNOWN, sale not finalized, receipt not printed, sale not synced, terminal offline — is visible and named, never implied away.

The language is light, quiet, dense, exact and Arabic-first. It is not a new look: it codifies the shipped 022 light pharmacy-teal system and the 023/V5 Sale screen, then completes them with the rules they lacked (numerals, focus, scanner ownership, density, states, themes, 1024/1280). The active-sale journey uses Direction B (OD-7): a cart-first workspace with a command bar, a persistent money column, and a slim navigation rail from Sale through Checkout to completion.

The visual weight of anything tracks its consequence — neutral < primary < warning < destructive — never brand flourish. It rejects dashboards, marketing gloss, playfulness, decoration and "AI app" aesthetics.
keyCharacteristics: Money is the loudest thing on screen, and the total / amount due is never scrolled out of view at 1024 or 1280.
One filled-teal primary per region; teal is the commit colour, not decoration.
Proven or labelled: success styling only for persisted facts (SETTLED, FINALIZED, PRINTED, POSTED).
Quiet when healthy, loud when actionable: a small persistent status indicator, banners only when the cashier must act or must know.
Keyboard and scanner first, touch-capable (44px floor); scanner input has one visible owner.
Arabic-first RTL; money, codes and quantities are LTR-isolated Western digits with tabular figures.
Light is the pilot register; Windows contrast themes (forced colours) must work; colour is never the only signal.

rules.name: The Commit-Teal Rule
rules.body: Filled teal appears on at most one control per region, plus selected-state washes. Large teal fills are allowed for the primary commit — the v3.5 One-Accent Rule is superseded.

rules.name: The No-Accent Rule
rules.body: There is no separate accent role. Selection is `primary-soft` fill + `primary` ink + a 2px inline-start bar + `aria-current`. The legacy `--color-accent` (equal to primary today) and the dark `--color-rail*` tokens exist only for legacy surfaces until VN-S10 retires them; new work never uses them.

rules.name: The Status-Containment Rule
rules.body: Status colours appear only on status surfaces: banner, indicator, badge, outcome panel, destructive button. Never as decoration, hover accent or brand fill.

rules.name: The Pending-Is-Not-Success Rule
rules.body: "Recorded but not yet proven downstream" (payment SETTLED while the sale is still FINALIZING; sale FINALIZED but not POSTED) uses info, not success. Success green is reserved for the proven fact the cashier is being told about.

rules.name: The UNKNOWN-Is-Not-A-Decline Rule
rules.body: An UNKNOWN card result uses the danger role with «النتيجة غير مؤكدة», never the word «مرفوض».

rules.name: The Twelve-Pixel Rule
rules.body: Nothing a cashier must read is below 12px; 11px exists only for keyboard-hint chips.

rules.name: The Arabic Leading Rule
rules.body: Arabic body text keeps line-height ≥ 1.5 — ascenders, descenders and dots clip at 1.25. Long product names wrap to two lines in the cart, then ellipsis, with the full name in the row's accessible name.

rules.name: The Plain Emphasis Rule
rules.body: No italics and no all-caps; weight carries emphasis. All-caps Latin codes hurt scanning of `O/0` and `I/1`.

rules.name: The Never-Scrolled-Away Rule
rules.body: At neither width may the total, the amount due, the safe back/cancel, suspend (when applicable) or the primary action be scrolled out of view.

rules.name: The Borders-Before-Shadows Rule
rules.body: Depth below the overlay level is expressed with hairlines and tint, never shadow.

rules.name: The Forced-Colours Rule
rules.body: Every state stays distinguishable in Windows contrast themes: outlines rather than shadows, text, icon or border on every state, `Highlight`/`HighlightText` on selected tiles, and `forced-color-adjust: none` only for product images. A forced-colours capture of every touched surface is part of each slice's evidence.

dos: Do keep the total (Sale) and amount due (Checkout) as the largest numerals, in tabular mono, visible without scrolling at 1024×768 and 1280×800.
Do use exactly one filled-teal primary per region and reserve the large commit (56px, full width) for the one next action.
Do isolate every money value, quantity and code as an LTR run with Western digits and tabular figures.
Do keep the money column in the same place from Sale through Checkout to completion (Direction B).
Do give every state text and/or an icon in addition to colour, and verify it under forced colours.
Do draw control boundaries with Control Edge (`border-strong`) and keep the hairline (`border`) for decorative dividers.
Do show the scan owner, and suspend scanning visibly while a dialog is open.
Do use info (Pending Blue) for recorded-but-unproven states and success only for proven facts.
Do tag anything not yet shipped with its VN slice, and stop and raise it if a visual choice would change RT-24 behaviour.
donts: Don't use the superseded v3.5 system — navy `#1f4e7a`, Inter, dark default, the One-Accent Rule, the dark command rail — for new work.
Don't use `--color-accent` or `--color-rail*` on new surfaces; they exist only until the legacy shell is retired (VN-S10).
Don't offer the dark theme or a theme toggle on cashier surfaces in the pilot.
Don't show success colour, a check icon or a success word before the underlying fact is persisted.
Don't call an UNKNOWN payment a decline, or a local sale "posted".
Don't auto-dismiss operational state (offline, sync attention, printer, drawer, shift closed) — those are persistent banners.
Don't animate money values during entry, or use bounce, elastic or decorative motion.
Don't bind financial confirmation to bare Enter, or show a keyboard hint for a key that is not bound.
Don't use shadows below the overlay level, nest panels, or put status colours on decoration.
Don't mix numeral systems on one screen, or write bilingual headings such as «طريقة الدفع (Payment method)».
Don't use the RT-27 Tower Blue palette or the 022 handoff's Saudi/ZATCA/15% VAT/mada content; they are references, not authority, for this Egyptian product.
